# core/poly1305.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/poly1305.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

The Poly1305 one-time authenticator (RFC 8439
section 2.5), in the 26-bit-limb form of poly1305-donna.

What is proved: every access is in bounds, nothing leaks, and a tag is 16
bytes. Not proved: that the tag is Poly1305's (the tests check the RFC 8439
vectors and a differential run against a reference on many lengths) or
that the code is constant time (there is no branch or index that depends on
the key or the message except the length, but nothing checks that).

A key must be used for one message only: two tags under one key reveal it.

`import "core/poly1305.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md), [core/endian.bastio](core-endian.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`poly1305`](#poly1305) | The Poly1305 tag of `m` under the 32-byte one-time `key` (`r` then `s`). |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `poly1305`

```bastio
fn poly1305(key: &Bytes, m: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  requires blen(key) == 32
  ensures blen(result) == 16
```

The Poly1305 tag of `m` under the 32-byte one-time `key` (`r` then `s`):
16 bytes.

Example:

```bastio
let mut key = balloc(32);
let mut i = 0;
while i < 32 invariant i <= 32 && blen(key) == 32 { bset(&mut key, i, cast[u8](i + 1)); i = i + 1; }
let m = bfrom("Cryptographic Forum Research Group");
let t = poly1305(key, m);
let n = blen(t);
bfree(t);
bfree(m);
bfree(key);
if n != 16 { return 1; }
```

## Internals

### `poly_word`

```bastio
fn poly_word(b: &Bytes, at: u64) -> u64
  requires at + 4 <= blen(b)
  ensures result < 4294967296
```

Internal: the little-endian 32-bit word at `at` of `b`, as a `u64`.

### `poly_block`

```bastio
fn poly_block(h: &mut Vec[u64], r: &Vec[u64], m: &Bytes, at: u64, hibit: u64)
  requires vlen(h) == 5 && vlen(r) == 9 && at + 16 <= blen(m)
  ensures vlen(h) == 5
```

Internal: adds the 16-byte block at `at` of `m` (with `hibit` the 2^128
bit, `16777216` for a full block, 0 for a padded one) to the accumulator
`h` (five 26-bit limbs) and multiplies by `r` (five limbs; `s` is `5 * r`
for limbs 1 to 4).
